description: A pre-existing backlog for the mock tracker, loaded by `make seed` before the agent writes anything. Deliberately messy, because the adapter contract requires that mocks return realistically messy data and that an agent which only works on clean data has not been tested. None of these items came from an extraction, so every source_ref is null.
planted_difficulties: MOCK-1 and MOCK-2 are near-duplicates of each other, with different wording and different assignees
MOCK-1, MOCK-6 and MOCK-11 have no assignee at all
status is free text throughout: 'In Progress ' carries trailing whitespace, 'blocked - waiting on IT' is a sentence, 'Done.' has a full stop, and casing is inconsistent
MOCK-3, MOCK-7 and MOCK-9 have due dates that were already in the past when the meetings took place
MOCK-4, MOCK-6, MOCK-8, MOCK-10 and MOCK-11 have no due date
MOCK-5 is closed but still assigned, and MOCK-12 is open with a due date two years out
MOCK-9's title is truncated, as though it were pasted from somewhere
labels are inconsistent: some kebab-case, some spaced, some absent
